ability to ask a lot of questions, seek out new information, and remain open to new ideas and perspectives.\n\n - The ability to self-serve, take initiative, and find resources necessary to accomplish a project or solve a problem\n\n - Enthusiasm for delivering value early and often to customers\n\n - Experience providing technical mentorship and sharing industry best practices, helping team members navigate complex engineering challenges and stay involved with the latest technologies and trends\n\n - Daily hands-on experience building with agentic AI tools, beyond autocomplete or chat: you delegate real work to agents as part of how you ship.\n   \n   \n\nIt would be really great (but not a deal-breaker) if you had:\n\n - Exposure or experience in a tech leadership role\n\n - Kafka knowledge and some basic AWS knowledge (e.g. Lambda, ECS, EC2)  \n\n - Experience using Ruby on Rails, React, and GraphQL in a production environment\n   \n   \n\nHiring Process:\n\n - An interview with a Talent team member (45 mins)\n\n - A Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins)\n\n -  A take-home challenge with a follow-up Functional Interview (90 mins)\n\n - A Senior Leadership Interview (30 mins)\n   \n   \n\nLocation:\n\nWe believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.\n\nCompensation:\n\nAt Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $125,800, a midpoint of $147,900, and a maximum salary of $170,100, designed to reflect the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling. \n\nWe design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth. \n\nBase salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development. We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!\n\nWhat you can expect from Jobber:\n\n - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.\n\n - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.\n\n - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.\n\n - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.\n\nWe believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. This includes identifying where customer-facing teams (sales, post-sales, support) can change their motions to drive better outcomes.\n\n - Experimenting with a range of actions (e.g. incentives) to drive payments adoption and usage, rapidly iterating based on results.\n\n - Defining the metrics that matter for payments GTM and holding yourself (and cross-functional partners) accountable to them.\n\n - Building deep working relationships across GTM teams, Product, RevOps, Analytics, etc. You are the connective tissue between these teams on payments GTM.\n\n - Using data and qualitative insights to find opportunities, size them, run experiments, and measure results.\n\n - Staying close to what other vertical SaaS and embedded payments players are doing. Knowing where Jobber can differentiate.\n\nTo be successful, you should have:\n\n - Operating and strategy experience, ideally a mix of both:\n   \n   - Operating experience: you have experience identifying opportunities, mobilizing teams, and driving measurable results. Could be Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Strategy & Operations, Product Commercialization, or a GM/Founder role, ideally at a scaling SaaS or Fintech company.\n   \n   - Strategy experience (valued): you have been a strategic partner to senior leaders, making data-driven recommendations. Examples could be Management Consulting, VC, or Strategy & Operations.\n\n - Deep understanding of payments and financial services business models, metrics, and growth strategies is desirable, particularly financial services for small businesses.\n\n - Strong data instincts. You use analytics to measure impact, make decisions, and optimize performance. You are not just comfortable with data, you reach for it first.\n\n - Experience using languages such as SQL to manipulate large data sets is a plus, but not required.\n\n - Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across GTM teams, Product, Executive Leadership, etc. You translate data into stories and strategies into action plans.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to design and implement scalable operational processes that enhance efficiency and ultimately drive growth.\n\n - Passion for helping small businesses succeed through innovative financial solutions.\n\n - A curious mind and a growth mindset. You are a scrappy learner who can quickly become an expert and build new capabilities.\n\n - A proactive drive to solve problems. You are capable of bringing structure to ambiguous problems, corralling resources, and delivering results.\n\n - A preference for working in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment. We’re growing fast and things are changing every day.\n\nLocation:\n\nWe believe great collaboration is intentional, and that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect from time to time. This role is open to candidates anywhere in Canada. Employees who live in one of our hub cities - Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo will participate in their department's in-office schedule, while employees outside our hub cities will work remotely.\n\nCompensation: \n\nAt Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200 a midpoint of $177,900 and a maximum salary of $204,500 designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.\n\nWe design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.\n\nBase salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. From the franchisor trying to manage fifty locations at once, to the franchisee who just wants to run their day without the software getting in the way.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">In this role, you'll own the strategy and execution behind Jobber Central and the broader franchise program. You'll work across a genuinely complex product surface: centralized billing, brand-level reporting, network controls, multi-location management. And you'll be doing it while sitting alongside Business Development in live partnership cycles, RFP responses, and roadmap conversations with prospective franchise partners.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You'll identify where the platform falls short for franchise customers, where the tension between franchisor control and franchisee experience creates real friction, and where the biggest opportunities are to make Jobber the obvious choice when a franchise group is deciding what to run their business on.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role is a strong fit for someone who is commercially sharp, deeply customer-curious, and comfortable operating at the intersection of product and partnership. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\nTHE PROBLEM YOU’D OWN\n\nJobber has AI in production, but not yet at its full potential.\n\nWe already have AI answering calls, drafting responses, and powering parts of our product. But today, those systems are still fragmented. Some teams are ahead. Others aren’t. Some workflows are intelligent. Others are still manual. And most importantly, the system doesn’t yet think across the product.\n\nA service pro still has to:\n\n - Manually follow up on jobs\n\n - Piece together context across workflows\n\n - Decide what to do next\n\nThe platform doesn’t proactively help them run their business. That’s the gap.\n\nThe opportunity is to evolve Jobber from: AI-powered features → AI-powered workflows → AI-powered business operations\n\nThis role owns that shift. Not a team. Not a feature. The system.\n\n\n\n\nTHE CUSTOMER\n\nYou’re building for people who don’t have time to think about software.\n\n - A plumber finishing their last job at 6 pm\n\n - A cleaner managing 30 clients and 5 employees\n\n - A landscaper juggling scheduling, payments, and follow-ups\n\nThey’re not asking for “AI.” They’re asking:\n\n - “What should I do next?”\n\n - “Why didn’t this job convert?”\n\n - “Who should I follow up with today?”\n\nAnd eventually:\n\n - They shouldn’t have to ask at all.\n\nThe Director who succeeds here will understand:\nThis isn’t about building clever systems; it’s about building systems that remove thinking from already overwhelmed people.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’D OWN\n\nEnd-to-end ownership of Jobber’s AI system layer. You’re not owning a single team. You’re owning how intelligence flows across the entire product.\n\n\n\n\nPRODUCT + PLATFORM SCOPE\n\n - AI Foundations (models, orchestration, evals, guardrails)\n\n - Copilot (user-facing intelligence layer)\n\n - Automations (workflow execution layer)\n\n - Platform Experience / Marketplace (integration + ecosystem surface)\n\n - Emerging surfaces (voice, messaging, cross-product intelligence)\n\n\nWHAT THIS ACTUALLY MEANS\n\nYou are responsible for:\n\n - How decisions get made inside the system\n\n - How context moves across workflows\n\n - How actions get triggered (and when they shouldn’t)\n\n - How we evaluate whether AI is actually working\n\nThis includes:\n\n - Agentic workflows (reason → decide → act → evaluate)\n\n - Cross-product context (jobs, customers, payments, communication)\n\n - Reliability, safety, and failure modes\n\n - Developer experience for building on top of AI systems\n\n\nTEAM STRUCTURE\n\n - ~30 engineers across 4–6 teams\n\n - 4–6 EMs / Sr EMs reporting into you\n\n - Close partnership with Product, Design, Data\n\n\n\n\nWHAT “GOOD” LOOKS LIKE\n\nNot “we shipped AI features.”\n\nInstead:\n\n - The system proactively recommends and takes actions\n\n - Teams build on shared AI primitives, not reinventing them\n\n - AI output is reliable, measurable, and improving over time\n\n - Engineers trust the system, and move faster because of it\n\n - Customers feel like the product is working for them, not just responding\n   \n   \n\n\nTHE AI BAR (THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT)\n\nWe are not looking for:\n\n - Someone who rolled out Copilot internally\n\n - Someone who used LLM APIs for features\n\n - Someone adjacent to AI\n\nWe are looking for someone who has:\n\nBuilt real systems where AI makes decisions and takes actions in production.\n\nThat means experience with:\n\n - Agent orchestration (not just prompts)\n\n - Tool use and workflow execution\n\n - Evaluation (offline + online)\n\n - Observability and failure handling\n\n - Guardrails and safety in real systems\n\n - Tradeoffs between autonomy vs. control\n\nYou don’t need to code daily, but you must be able to reason at the system level.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO\n\n - Define how AI should work across Jobber, not just within a team\n\n - Build and evolve a multi-team org to execute on that vision\n\n - Make tradeoffs between speed, quality, and safety\n\n - Push teams beyond feature thinking into system thinking\n\n - Challenge assumptions, including leadership’s\n\n - Drive adoption across engineering, product, and the company\n\n\n\n\nWHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR\n\n\nLEADERSHIP\n\nYou’ve led orgs through complexity, not just growth.\n\n - Managed managers across multiple teams\n\n - Built organizations that scale (not just teams that ship)\n\n - Driven cross-org alignment in ambiguous spaces\n\n\nPRODUCT + SYSTEMS THINKING\n\nYou think in systems, not features.\n\n - You understand how user workflows connect end-to-end\n\n - You’ve partnered deeply with Product and Design\n\n - You care about customer outcomes, not just technical output\n\n\nAI DEPTH (NON-NEGOTIABLE)\n\nYou’ve built or led production LLM/agentic systems.\n\n - You understand what actually works (and what doesn’t)\n\n - You’ve seen systems fail and improved them\n\n - You have opinions about evaluation, reliability, and safety\n\n\nEXECUTION\n\nYou can move fast without breaking everything.\n\n - You’ve balanced shipping vs infrastructure vs tech debt\n\n - You know when to iterate and when to redesign\n\n\n\n\nWHY JOBBER · WHY NOW?\n\nThis is not “AI theatre.”\n\nWe already have:\n\n - AI Receptionist (live, handling real customer calls)\n\n - AI features embedded across the product\n\n - 250,000+ businesses using the platform\n\nWhat we don’t have yet is: A unified, intelligent system across the product.\n\nThat’s what this role builds.\n\n\n\n\nTLDR:\n\nMost Director roles optimize delivery. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. This team helps keep that stack running smoothly while also improving the systems, processes, and automations that support our revenue teams at scale.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>The role:</strong></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Reporting to the Senior Manager, Revenue Technology, the <strong>Revenue Technology Manager </strong>will own core RevTech operational processes, provide first-line support across key tools, investigate and scope incoming requests, and partner with RevTech and Sales Operations teammates on larger project rollouts. You won’t just execute repeatable processes — you’ll help make them better. You’ll identify patterns, design cleaner workflows, contribute to AI-enabled automation, and support the rollout of solutions that help our GTM teams move faster and operate more effectively. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, systems-minded, service-oriented, and excited by the opportunity to use AI and automation to reduce manual work.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The <strong>Revenue Technology Manager</strong> will work on : </p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>RevTech Operations &amp; User Lifecycle Management</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own end-to-end onboarding, offboarding, and user lifecycle processes across Jobber’s GTM tech stack.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Provision and deprovision access, assign licenses, and configure team memberships, distributions, and user settings across tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Revenue.io, ChiliPiper, TextExpander, and MuleSoft.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Maintain accurate records of user access, tool configurations, and operational dependencies.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify opportunities to improve the user lifecycle experience through clearer process design, stronger documentation, automation, and AI-enabled support.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Tool Support, Triage &amp; Issue Resolution</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Monitor RevTech support and intake channels, serving as a first point of contact for tool-related questions, access issues, and operational requests.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Diagnose and resolve common issues independently, escalating complex or platform-level problems with clear context, impact, and recommended next steps.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Track recurring issues, identify patterns, and recommend process, documentation, system, or automation improvements to reduce repeat volume.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Partner with RevTech team members to improve how requests are captured, prioritized, routed, and resolved.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>RevTech Intake, Investigation &amp; Minor Builds</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Triage incoming RevTech requests by assessing scope, priority, business impact, dependencies, and ownership.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Investigate requests by reviewing relevant records, understanding the current process or system state, and identifying blockers, risks, or downstream impacts.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"> Action minor Salesforce and GTM tooling requests independently, including field additions, picklist updates, list view changes, data activation requests, user configuration updates, and other low-risk system changes.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Route larger or more complex requests with well-formed context, including a clear problem statement, current-state findings, impacted teams, known dependencies, and recommended next steps.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>AI, Automation &amp; Process Improvement</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Help identify recurring manual processes that can be streamlined, automated, or supported through AI.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Partner with RevTech and Sales Operations teammates to design, test, and improve AI-enabled workflows that support onboarding, intake triage, support resolution, documentation, data validation, and operational reporting.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Contribute to the development of prompts, process logic, workflow documentation, and quality checks that enable AI tools to support RevTech operations safely and effectively.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Evaluate automation opportunities with a practical lens, balancing speed, accuracy, user experience, governance, and long-term maintainability.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Larger Project Rollout Support</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Support larger Sales Operations and RevTech project rollouts by helping gather requirements, document current-state processes, identify operational impacts, and prepare teams for change.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Consult with stakeholders to understand how proposed solutions will be executed in practice, including handoffs, ownership, intake paths, user behaviour, documentation, and support needs.</p></li><li><p checklists, and post-launch monitoring.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Assist with user acceptance testing, deployment validation, rollout communications, and adoption tracking.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Surface technical risks, gaps, or unclear ownership areas before launch so the team can deliver cleaner and more scalable solutions.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Platform Auditing, Validation &amp; Data Quality</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Conduct periodic audits of Salesforce licenses, profiles, permission sets, validation rules, formulas, fields, and related configurations to support platform accuracy and hygiene.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify stale, redundant, misconfigured, or underused platform elements and recommend cleanup or governance actions.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Support validation efforts when changes are deployed, helping confirm expected behaviour across affected users, teams, records, and workflows.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Execute Salesforce data loads with accuracy, following established governance and review processes.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Validate data before and after In essence, Analytics is a central function that exists to drive business outcomes in all corners of Jobber’s ecosystem.\n\nThe Role:\n\nReporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Analytics, the Senior Business Data Scientist, Marketing will be a senior analytics partner for one or more of Jobber’s high-priority Customer Analytics domains.\n\nThis role will partner closely with business leaders and cross-functional teams to help Jobber better understand customer behaviour, business performance, growth opportunities, and the drivers of long-term customer value. Depending on business priorities, this work may span areas such as acquisition, onboarding, lifecycle engagement, product adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, customer success, or other strategic customer domains.\n\nYou will lead high-impact analytical work across the customer journey, including funnel performance, customer segmentation, conversion, engagement, product usage, retention, expansion, operational effectiveness, and long-term value.\n\nThis is an individual contributor leadership role, not a people leadership role. You will not directly manage a team, but you will be expected to lead through influence, own one or more important business domains, shape analytical roadmaps, mentor and guide analysts, manage senior stakeholder relationships, and ensure analytics work translates into better decisions.\n\nThe ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, deep analytical expertise, and excellent communication skills. They are comfortable turning ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches, building clear recommendations, and influencing decisions at multiple levels of the organization.\n\n \n\n\nTHE SENIOR BUSINESS DATA SCIENTIST, MARKETING WILL:\n\nLead strategic customer analytics and insight\n\n - Act as a strategic thought partner and internal consultant to stakeholders across one or more high-priority Customer Analytics domains, helping them clarify business questions, evaluate opportunities, measure performance, and make better decisions.\n\n - Collaborate closely with teams across Jobber, including Revenue Operations, Strategy, Marketing Analytics, Product & Fintech Analytics, BI & Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and relevant go-to-market or customer-facing teams.\n\n - Lead deep-dive analyses across the customer journey, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, product adoption, monetization, retention, expansion, customer quality, and long-term customer value.\n\n - Help define, refine, and govern the KPIs that matter most for the assigned domain or domains, including performance, efficiency, customer quality, customer outcomes, and downstream business impact.\n\n - Translate complex business questions into clear analytical plans, decision frameworks, and actionable recommendations.\n\n - Evaluate the impact of strategic initiatives, operational changes, go-to-market motions, customer programs, product or lifecycle initiatives, and other business priorities.\n\n - Help leaders understand not just what happened, but why it happened, what it means, and what Jobber should do next.\n\nSupport decision-making across assigned domains\n\n - Build a strong analytical understanding of the assigned domain or domains, including how different customer segments, behaviours, channels, products, teams, or motions contribute to business performance.\n\n - Identify opportunities to improve growth, efficiency, prioritization, customer experience, customer quality, and long-term value.\n\n - Support strategic planning, forecasting, target setting, business cases, and resource allocation decisions.\n\n - Partner with cross-functional teams and business leaders to improve reporting foundations, metric definitions, funnel or journey visibility, and decision-making workflows.\n\n - Analyze the quality and long-term value of different customer groups, helping Jobber optimize for durable growth rather than short-term volume alone.\n\n - Create reusable frameworks and decision tools that help teams evaluate trade-offs across growth, efficiency, customer outcomes, and operational complexity.\n\nDrive experimentation, impact evaluation, and advanced analytics\n\n - Support experimentation and measurement strategies for strategic initiatives, including A/B tests, pilots, campaigns, lifecycle programs, product initiatives, operational changes, and customer-facing programs.\n\n - Apply advanced analytics techniques such as impact evaluation, scenario analysis, simulation modelling, forecasting, segmentation, and predictive analytics to inform strategic decisions.\n\n - Partner with Data Science on more complex modelling opportunities, such as customer scoring, prioritization, churn or expansion propensity, automation, AI-assisted workflows, or other predictive systems.\n\n - Bring strong judgment to ambiguous measurement problems, including cases where perfect experimentation is not possible and directional decision support is still needed.\n\n - Help stakeholders understand analytical confidence, limitations, trade-offs, and recommended next actions.\n\nBuild trusted stakeholder partnerships and executive-ready communication\n\n - Build trusted relationships with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders by understanding their goals, shaping analytical roadmaps, and proactively identifying opportunities.\n\n - Communicate insights through clear, compelling, executive-ready narratives that connect analysis to decisions and business outcomes.\n\n - Present findings, recommendations, dashboards, and decision frameworks in business reviews, leadership forums, and cross-functional meetings.\n\n - Make trade-offs visible when stakeholder demand exceeds capacity, helping teams prioritize the work that will have the greatest business impact.\n\n - Collaborate across Analytics & Insights to ensure Customer Analytics work connects cleanly with other analytics teams and pods, BI & Analytics Engineering, and Data Science.\n\nAdvance scalable analytics and AI-enabled workflows\n\n - Identify recurring or repeatable analytics work that should become automated, standardized, documented, or moved into self-serve.\n\n - Partner with BI & Analytics Engineering to improve the data foundation, semantic layer, reporting infrastructure, and self-serve capabilities that support Customer Analytics decision-making.\n\n - Use AI-assisted analytics workflows responsibly to accelerate exploration, coding, documentation, QA, and storytelling while maintaining strong ownership of output quality.\n\n - Promote high-quality analytics practices, including clear metric definitions, reproducible workflows, thoughtful QA, documentation, peer review, and data quality stewardship.\n\n - Build scalable assets, dashboards, models, and analytical frameworks that reduce manual reporting and shift analyst time toward higher-judgment work.\n\n - Ensure insights are timely, trusted, actionable, and connected to meaningful business outcomes.\n   \n    \n\nLead as a senior individual contributor, you will:\n\n - Lead one or more important Customer Analytics domains through influence, ownership, and strong judgment.\n\n - Provide mentorship, peer review, and analytical guidance to analysts working in or adjacent to those domains.\n\n - Raise the bar for analytical quality, stakeholder communication, and business impact across the Customer Analytics team.\n\n - Contribute to team-wide best practices around prioritization, documentation, QA, AI-enabled workflows, self-serve, and strategic storytelling.\n\n - Operate as a senior individual contributor who can independently own ambiguous, high-impact work while helping others grow.\n\n\n\nTo be successful, you should have:\n\n - Expert-level SQL skills, with the ability to work efficiently across complex relational data structures and validate analytical logic with confidence.\n\n - Strong experience in B2B SaaS, marketplace, fintech, revenue, growth, product, customer, or go-to-market analytics.\n\n - A deep understanding of SaaS business models and customer journey metrics, such as funnel performance, conversion, activation, engagement, retention, expansion, monetization, customer quality, and customer value.\n\n - Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, with a focus on clear, compelling, and actionable reporting and narratives.\n\n - Demonstrated experience with foundational and advanced analytics techniques, including performance measurement, exploratory analysis, impact evaluation, experimentation, forecasting, scenario analysis, simulation modelling, and predictive analytics.\n\n - Strong business acumen and strategic judgment, with the ability to connect analytical work to company-level growth, efficiency, and customer outcomes.\n\n - Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, clarify ambiguous asks, influence priorities, and guide leaders toward better decisions.\n\n - A passion for storytelling through data, with the ability to distill complex analyses into simple, influential insights.\n\n - Practical fluency with AI-assisted analytics workflows, with the judgment to use AI responsibly, validate outputs, and own the quality of the final work.\n\n - Intellectual curiosity, creativity, and adaptability in solving open-ended business problems in a fast-moving environment.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to mentor analysts, lead through influence, and operate as a senior individual contributor owning one or more business domains.\n\n - Proven ability to thrive under pressure, navigate ambiguity, and bring structure to complex or competing demands.\n\n - Experience with Python, dbt, Snowflake, Salesforce or other CRM/customer systems, data modelling, and productionized analytics workflows is a strong asset.\n\nYou should also:\n\n - Be proactive and resourceful, with a bias for action. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving conceptual problems, corralling resources, and delivering results independently.\n\n - Communicate with clarity and confidence. You actively listen, empathize with stakeholders, and translate complex concepts into simple, actionable insights.\n\n - Care deeply about quality. You value strong analytical foundations, thoughtful QA, documentation, peer review, and reproducible work.\n\n - Be comfortable making trade-offs visible. You know how to focus on the highest-impact work while helping stakeholders understand what must be deprioritized.\n\n - Be excited about the future of analytics. You see AI, automation, and self-serve not just as productivity tools, but as opportunities to redesign how analytics teams create impact.\n\n - Lead without authority. You can influence senior stakeholders, guide peers, mentor analysts, and move important work forward without relying on formal people management authority.\n\n - Thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment. You adapt quickly, embrace change, and stay focused even when yesterday’s playbook no longer applies.\n\n \n\nLocation:\n\nWe believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.\n\n \n\nCompensation:\n\nAt Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $151,200, a midpoint of $177,900, and a maximum salary of $204,500, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.\n\nWe design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.\n\nBase salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.\n\nWe believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. When attribution is broken, delayed, or inconsistent, it introduces real risk and slows decision-making. This role creates dedicated focus, faster feedback loops, fewer errors, and higher confidence for key stakeholders—while also strengthening continuity and resilience across RevOps.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>The Marketing Data Manager will:</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Evolve Attribution Modelling &amp; Methodology</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Manage and improve our first-touch attribution model, incorporating new signals and partnering with Analytics to align on business definitions, methodology, and interpretation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Enhance our multi-touch attribution model, including bringing in non-clickable sources such as connected TV and Salesforce data, in partnership with Analytics on methodology and interpretation.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build model comparison analyses and reporting to evaluate newly developed models against existing first-touch and multi-touch approaches.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Act as the primary point of contact for diagnosing attribution inconsistencies, partnering with Marketing and Customer Analytics stakeholders to understand perceived under-performance and uncover root causes in data and configuration.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data Integration &amp; Attribution Infrastructure</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Integrate new marketing attribution sources end-to-end, including partnering with our data teams to develop reverse ETL models and seed tables needed to sync data into the attribution systems</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Maintain and update attribution seed tables (e.g., adding influencers/partners and implementing UTM mapping changes). Partner with BI to review published PRs and confirm changes meet standards for accuracy, integrity, and alignment with attribution logic.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Monitor and validate UTM structures and attribution signals, proactively identifying mapping issues and irregularities that impact reporting accuracy.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Coordinate with Ad Operations to ensure tracking configurations align with attribution needs and that collected web data is structured and usable for modelling.</p></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Data Modelling</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Write and maintain production-quality SQL to analyze raw marketing, product, and revenue signals into analysis-ready and reverse ETL datasets.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Translate data analysis into dimensional/semantic model requirements (e.g., clean attribution-ready tables, standardized channel mappings, and reusable metrics definitions) that downstream reporting and stakeholders can trust.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Collaborate with the relevant data teams to review and maintain data models that support first-touch and multi-touch attribution, including new source onboarding, table improvements, and model comparison reporting.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Review and maintain quality checks and validation logic to ensure changes to data models, UTMs, and attribution logic don’t break downstream reporting.</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Partner with BI and stakeholders to align on definitions, logic, and documentation, ensuring datasets are understood, governed, and reusable across configuration</p></li></ul></li></ul></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Support Applied Top-of-Funnel Analytics &amp; Growth Operations</strong></p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p When attribution is broken, delayed, or inconsistent, it introduces real risk and slows decision-making. This role creates dedicated focus, faster feedback loops, fewer errors, and higher confidence for key stakeholders—while also strengthening continuity and resilience across RevOps.\n\n\n\n\nTHE MARKETING DATA MANAGER WILL:\n\n - Evolve Attribution Modelling & Methodology\n   \n   - Manage and improve our first-touch attribution model, incorporating new signals and partnering with Analytics to align on business definitions, methodology, and interpretation.\n   \n   - Enhance our multi-touch attribution model, including bringing in non-clickable sources such as connected TV and Salesforce data, in partnership with Analytics on methodology and interpretation.\n   \n   - Build model comparison analyses and reporting to evaluate newly developed models against existing first-touch and multi-touch approaches.\n   \n   - Act as the primary point of contact for diagnosing attribution inconsistencies, partnering with Marketing and Customer Analytics stakeholders to understand perceived under-performance and uncover root causes in data and configuration.\n\n - Data Integration & Attribution Infrastructure\n   \n   - Integrate new marketing attribution sources end-to-end, including partnering with our data teams to develop reverse ETL models and seed tables needed to sync data into the attribution systems\n   \n   - Maintain and update attribution seed tables (e.g., adding influencers/partners and implementing UTM mapping changes). Partner with BI to review published PRs and confirm changes meet standards for accuracy, integrity, and alignment with attribution logic.\n   \n   - Monitor and validate UTM structures and attribution signals, proactively identifying mapping issues and irregularities that impact reporting accuracy.\n   \n   - Coordinate with Ad Operations to ensure tracking configurations align with attribution needs and that collected web data is structured and usable for modelling.\n\n - Data Modelling\n   \n   - Write and maintain production-quality SQL to analyze raw marketing, product, and revenue signals into analysis-ready and reverse ETL datasets.\n   \n   - Translate data analysis into dimensional/semantic model requirements (e.g., clean attribution-ready tables, standardized channel mappings, and reusable metrics definitions) that downstream reporting and stakeholders can trust.\n   \n   - Collaborate with the relevant data teams to review and maintain data models that support first-touch and multi-touch attribution, including new source onboarding, table improvements, and model comparison reporting.\n   \n   - Review and maintain quality checks and validation logic to ensure changes to data models, UTMs, and attribution logic don’t break downstream reporting.\n   \n   - Partner with BI and stakeholders to align on definitions, logic, and documentation, ensuring datasets are understood, governed, and reusable across the org\n\n - Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Enablement\n   \n   - Lead attribution onboarding/training for new Marketing hires, including how account-level attribution is derived and interpreted\n   \n   - Proven skill in diagnosing complex inconsistencies across tracking, data pipelines, and business logic.\n\n - Comfort partnering cross-functionally (RevOps, Marketing, BI, Ad Ops) and translating technical work into clear, practical guidance.\n\n - This opportunity has a fixed compensation structure, meaning all employees come in at the exact same rate.  It includes a base salary of $50,000 and a commission of $30,000, for an On-Target Earnings (OTE) of $80,000. Our commission structure is uncapped and paid out monthly, meaning there is potential to earn beyond the stated OTE.\n\nThis OTE is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. You’ll pair this with qualitative insights to drive stronger outcomes and influence stakeholders through evidence.\n\n - Build strong, diverse talent pipelines through strategic sourcing, campaigns, events, and sustained outreach that nurtures long-term engagement across underrepresented communities.\n\n - Bring an experimental, builder's mindset to the role: prototype and pressure-test new tools, workflows, or AI-assisted approaches that make our recruitment process faster or better, and share what you learn with the rest of the team.\n\n - Promote inclusive hiring by embedding equitable and unbiased practices throughout the recruitment process, aligned with our approach to diversity and inclusion.\n\n - Act as an advocate and coach on recruitment best practices and standards for all things technical recruitment. You bring experience and can influence stakeholders towards outcomes supported by our objectives.\n\n - Strengthen our employer brand by championing Jobber as a purpose-driven and people-first workplace.\n\n - Become an ambassador of our culture by being humble, supportive – and someone who truly gives a sh*t! You will represent Jobber with the highest degree of professionalism.\n\n\n\n\nTO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU SHOULD HAVE:\n\n - Proven full-cycle in-house recruitment experience in SaaS or a high-growth, fast-paced environment, specifically in the business and go-to-market areas.\n\n - A track record of quality delivery across multiple roles and role types, with the ability to manage complexity and manage pace without losing detail.\n\n - A data-informed mindset. You understand funnel metrics, hiring trends, and how to use insights to influence and improve.\n\n - A demonstrated builder's relationship with AI: you've used AI tools to build something in your own recruiting practice (a sourcing workflow, a screening tool, an automation, a prompt library) — not just used AI as a passive assistant — and you can speak concretely to what you built and what it changed.\n\n - A compelling communication style and creative sourcing approach. You know how to tell a story that connects and drives action.\n\n - Strong relationship-building skills. You’re a partner to hiring managers and an advocate for inclusive hiring practices.\n\n - A deep commitment to exceptional candidate experience, from first contact to final offer.\n\n\n\n\nCOMPENSATION:\n\nAt Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $71,400, a midpoint of $84,000 and a maximum salary of $96,600. \n\nWe design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact. For this role, we're starting in the earlier portion of the range with room to grow further into the band as the role's scope and impact expand. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both the current shape of the role and the opportunity for growth as it evolves.\n\nBase salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. You adapt frameworks to the situation in front of you, and where there is no precedent, you build the approach. You work independently and check in on the decisions that matter.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a hands-on role at both ends of the range. You will partner directly with the senior leaders and executives who run your group, bringing them a recommendation rather than a question. You will spend time coaching managers who are leading people for the first time, becoming their essential partner as they learn, and you will also spend real time on leave administration, performance documentation, and employee relations case management. You’ll collaborate with partners such as Google, Zapier, Gusto, The Home Depot, and others to bring joint initiatives to market, while also supporting franchise, referral, and association partnerships that contribute to customer acquisition, partner-sourced growth, and ecosystem expansion.\n\nSuccess in this role means increasing integration adoption, driving partner-sourced revenue growth, and building scalable programs that strengthen Jobber’s partner ecosystem.\n\n\n\nThe Partner Marketing Manager will:\n\n - Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for partnership initiatives, including co-marketing campaigns, product launches, content, events, marketplace promotions, and demand generation programs.\n\n - Build and manage partner relationships, collaborating on joint marketing plans, co-marketing programs, and growth initiatives that create value for customers, partners, and Jobber.\n\n - Develop positioning, messaging, enablement resources, and go-to-market assets that clearly communicate the value of partner solutions and integrations.\n\n - Partner with teams across Product, Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, Enablement, and Design to bring partner initiatives to market and improve how customers discover and adopt partner solutions.\n\n - Gather customer, partner, competitive, and market insights to identify growth opportunities, inform strategy, and strengthen partner programs.\n\n - Own partner marketing performance metrics, including integration adoption, marketplace engagement, partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, and campaign performance, and use data to optimize programs and drive business impact.\n\n\n\nTo be successful you should have:\n\n - 4+ years of experience in partner marketing, product marketing, ecosystem marketing, or a related B2B SaaS go-to-market role.\n\n - Experience supporting go-to-market initiatives for technology integrations, platform ecosystems, app marketplaces, or strategic technology partnerships.\n\n - Proven track record of developing and executing co-marketing programs with external partners.\n\n - Strong positioning and messaging skills — you can translate integrations and partner solutions into clear, compelling customer value.\n\n - Experience building and executing integrated marketing campaigns across multiple channels.\n\n - Strong program management skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.\n\n - Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills; you’re comfortable working cross-functionally and directly with external partners.\n\n - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.\n\n - Data-driven mindset — you use performance data and customer insights to guide decisions and improve outcomes.\n\n - Ability to work independently, stay organized, and move projects forward in a fast-paced environment.\n\n - Willingness to travel occasionally for partner events.\n\nNice to haves\n\n - Experience working at a SaaS platform where third-party integrations are a core part of the customer experience.\n\n - Experience supporting franchise networks, referral partner programs, associations, or other channel partnership models.\n\n - Familiarity with app marketplace ecosystems, partner portals, developer programs, or ecosystem growth strategies.\n\n - Experience with partner ecosystem tools (e.g. Crossbeam) and partner attribution methodologies.\n\n - Experience working in a fast-growing company.\n\n\n\nCompensation:\n\nAt Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $98,300, a midpoint of $115,700 and a maximum salary of $133,100, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.\n\nWe design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.\n\nBase salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Analytics, this leader will manage a team of analysts and partner closely with Directors, Senior Directors, and VPs across Demand Generation, Brand Marketing & Communications, Sales, Partnerships, MarketingOps, SalesOps, and Finance.\n\nIn this role, you will set the technical, methodological, and strategic direction for high-impact Sales and Marketing analytics. You will own the measurement infrastructure that helps Jobber connect acquisition investment to subscription revenue growth, understand marketing effectiveness, evaluate channel and partnership performance, and improve visibility into CAC, LTV, payback, sales efficiency, revenue funnel performance, and go-to-market ROI.\n\nThis role requires a leader who combines strong people leadership, hands-on technical depth, and deep Sales and Marketing domain expertise. You will build trusted relationships with senior leaders, raise the bar for analytical quality, and develop analysts who can translate rigorous measurement into better growth decisions.\n\nYou will also help Jobber advance Analytics 2.0 in practice by using self-serve analytics, automation, responsible AI, and agentic workflows to scale trusted decision support and create more capacity for strategic, high-judgment analytical work.\n\n\n\n \n\n\nWHAT YOU'LL OWN\n\nTeam Leadership & Analytics Operating Model\n\n - Hire, onboard, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of analysts supporting Demand Generation, Brand Marketing & Communications, Sales, and Partnerships, setting clear expectations and building the team’s capabilities as Jobber’s Sales and Marketing analytics needs scale.\n\n - Establish a clear engagement and prioritization model for Sales and Marketing Analytics, creating scalable operating rhythms that balance strategic analysis, recurring reporting, cross-functional initiatives, self-serve enablement, and ad hoc stakeholder needs.\n\n - Build a culture of analytical excellence, high accountability, curiosity, strong QA, documentation, peer review, business ownership, and continuous improvement.\n\n - Partner with Analytics Engineering, BI, Data Science, Data Engineering, MarketingOps, and SalesOps to strengthen the data foundation, metric definitions, reporting infrastructure, and governed datasets that support Sales and Marketing decision-making.\n\nSales & Marketing Analytics Strategy\n\n - Lead the analytics roadmap across Jobber’s Marketing & Channels and Sales & Partnerships pods, ensuring the team is focused on the highest-impact opportunities across customer acquisition, demand generation, sales productivity, channel performance, partnership growth, and revenue efficiency.\n\n - Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to define success metrics, identify growth opportunities, evaluate strategic bets, and translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.\n\n - Help Jobber understand not just what is happening across the go-to-market funnel, but why it is happening, what it means, and what leaders should do next.\n\nPerformance Marketing, Demand Generation & Channel Measurement\n\n - Define and evolve Jobber’s marketing measurement framework across Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), incrementality, experimentation, and forecasting, ensuring these methods work together as a unified system for decision-making rather than as siloed tools.\n\n - Lead the design and operationalization of advanced marketing measurement approaches, including MMM, MTA, incrementality testing, spend efficiency curves, saturation analysis, and diminishing returns modelling, connecting marketing and channel investment to subscription revenue, CAC, payback, LTV, pipeline quality, and long-term customer value.\n\n - Set standards for how analysts select, build, quality-assure, and interpret advanced measurement methods, including when to use MMM, MTA, incrementality testing, causal inference, forecasting, or simpler diagnostic approaches.\n\n - Partner with Performance Marketing, Demand Generation, Brand Marketing & Communications, Partnerships, Finance, and MarketingOps to evaluate spend efficiency, channel mix, conversion quality, saturation, diminishing returns, and budget allocation trade-offs, including scenario analysis ahead of planning cycles.\n\nSales, Partnerships & Revenue Funnel Analytics\n\n - Lead analytics that help Sales and Partnerships leaders understand funnel health, lead quality, conversion performance, rep and team productivity, pipeline creation, sales-assisted revenue, partner/referral performance, and opportunities to improve go-to-market efficiency.\n\n - Build frameworks, dashboards, models, and decision-support tools that help leaders monitor performance, diagnose issues, and make better planning, resourcing, and prioritization decisions.\n\n - Connect sales and marketing performance into a unified view of acquisition economics, helping Jobber understand how demand, channel mix, sales motion, and customer quality translate into durable revenue growth.\n\nExecutive Influence & Storytelling\n\n - Bring an analytical perspective to growth strategy, planning, investment decisions, and operating reviews with Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders.\n\n - Translate complex analytical work into clear narratives, trade-offs, and recommendations that senior leaders can act on.\n\nAnalytics 2.0 & AI-Powered Decision Support\n\n - Contribute to Jobber’s Analytics 2.0 roadmap by identifying where AI, ML, automation, and agentic analytics can accelerate Sales and Marketing measurement, forecasting, diagnostics, storytelling, and self-serve decision support.\n\n - Partner with Analytics Engineering, BI, Data Science, and Data Engineering to operationalize AI-assisted workflows and analytics agents for anomaly detection, campaign diagnostics, forecasting, attribution, causal inference, narrative generation, documentation, and QA.\n\n - Champion governed self-serve analytics and trusted metrics so Sales and Marketing leaders can answer recurring performance questions without routing every request through an analyst, while preserving analytical quality and clear ownership.\n\n - Help analysts adopt AI responsibly, validating outputs, understanding limitations, documenting methods, and using automation to create more capacity for strategic modelling and business influence.\n\n \n\n\nWHAT YOU BRING\n\nSales & Marketing Analytics Expertise\n\n - Deep experience in Sales, Marketing, Growth, Revenue, Demand Generation, Performance Marketing, Channels, Partnerships, or GTM analytics, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or subscription business.\n\n - Strong understanding of customer acquisition economics, including CAC, LTV, payback period, funnel conversion, pipeline quality, channel performance, sales efficiency, partner/referral performance, and subscription revenue growth.\n\n - Deep, hands-on experience with marketing and GTM measurement approaches, including attribution, incrementality testing, experimentation, forecasting, budget allocation, and the practical limitations of each method.\n\n - Experience helping senior Sales and Marketing leaders define success metrics, evaluate performance, diagnose growth opportunities, and make better decisions across the go-to-market funnel.\n\n - Familiarity with marketing, sales, CRM, ad platform, lifecycle, partnerships, and revenue funnel data, including paid search, paid social, organic, referral, brand, partnerships, lifecycle marketing, and platform-specific measurement constraints from tools such as Google Ads, Meta, and programmatic ad platforms.\n\n - Hands-on experience building or significantly contributing to advanced marketing measurement approaches such as Marketing Mix Modelling, Multi-Touch Attribution, incrementality experiments, geo or matched-market tests, synthetic control, spend efficiency curves, or causal inference methods, with the judgment to evaluate, challenge, and improve vendor or platform-reported outputs.\n\nTechnical & Methodological Skills\n\n - Expert-level SQL skills, with the ability to work across complex data structures, build analytical datasets, and review analytical logic with confidence.\n\n - Strong hands-on analytical skills, including performance measurement, exploratory analysis, cohort analysis, impact evaluation, experimentation, forecasting, scenario analysis, segmentation, predictive modelling, and causal inference techniques such as difference-in-differences, synthetic control, propensity score matching, or regression discontinuity.\n\n - Strong proficiency in Python or R for modelling, automation, statistical analysis, and productionized analytics workflows; experience with MMM libraries or statistical modelling frameworks such as Robyn, Meridian, PyMC-Marketing, Bayesian modelling frameworks, or equivalent tools is a strong asset.\n\n - Strong statistical judgment, including comfort with confidence intervals, effect size estimation, variance, seasonality, bias, model uncertainty, and balancing analytical rigour with pragmatic business decision-making.\n\n - Experience with modern data stacks and BI tools such as dbt, Snowflake, Redshift, Looker, Tableau, or similar platforms, with a strong ability to build scalable, trusted reporting and decision-support assets.\n\nBusiness & Leadership Skills\n\n - Proven experience as a people leader in analytics, with a strong track record of developing, coaching, and empowering high-performing analysts.\n\n - Strong strategic judgment, with the ability to shape priorities, influence senior leaders, and connect analytical work to company-level growth outcomes.\n\n - Experience owning an analytics roadmap in a fast-moving environment with competing stakeholder needs and high-impact business decisions.\n\n - Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, clarify ambiguous asks, manage trade-offs, and influence Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, and cross-functional leaders through data-backed recommendations.\n\n - Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis, uncertainty, and trade-offs into clear executive-ready narratives.\n\n - Demonstrated ability to lead AI-assisted analytics adoption across a team, including identifying high-value use cases, setting QA and governance expectations, validating outputs, improving documentation, accelerating analysis, and helping analysts use AI to deliver better decision support without compromising quality.\n\n \n\n\nWHO YOU ARE\n\n - You are a strategic analytics leader who can operate at multiple altitudes. You can zoom into technical details when needed, but you always connect the work back to business decisions and outcomes.\n\n - You are a strong people leader who creates clarity, raises the bar, and helps analysts do the best work of their careers.\n\n - You are proactive and resourceful. You do not wait to be handed perfectly formed questions; you identify the highest-value problems, frame the trade-offs, and guide stakeholders toward better decisions.\n\n - You are deeply curious about Sales and Marketing performance. You want to understand what drives acquisition, conversion, channel effectiveness, sales efficiency, partnership growth, and long-term customer value.\n\n - You hold a high bar for analytical quality and measurement rigour, while staying pragmatic about what is useful, deployable, and decision-relevant in a real business environment.\n\n - You communicate with clarity and confidence, especially when explaining uncertainty, trade-offs, and imperfect evidence to senior stakeholders.\n\n - You are comfortable making trade-offs visible. You know how to say yes to the highest-impact work while helping stakeholders understand what must be deprioritized.\n\n - You are excited by Analytics 2.0. This role has a minimum annual salary of $50,000, a midpoint of $58,800, and a maximum salary of $67,600, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.\n\nWe design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers between the minimum to the midpoint reflect strong potential with transferable work experience. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.\n\nBase salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.\n\nWe believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!\n\n\n\nHow This Works — Talent Pool\n\nThis is an evergreen posting, which means we're actively building a pipeline for future openings rather than hiring for one specific vacancy right now.\n\n\n\nHere's what to expect:\n\n - You'll complete up to three stages of our process: a brief recorded audio assignment (Willo), a conversation with our Talent Attraction team, and an interview with a hiring manager.\n\n - Candidates who are a strong fit will be added to our talent pool and contacted when a role opens up.\n\n - We keep active candidates in our pool for up to 3 months, and we'll check in with you periodically in the meantime.\n\n - If a role opens and you're still interested, we'll move quickly to bring you through the final steps.\n\n\n\nWe know your time is valuable, and we're committed to being transparent with you throughout the process. If your circumstances change or you'd like to withdraw from the pool at any time, just let us know.\n\nWhat you can expect from Jobber:\n\n - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.\n\n - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.\n\n - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.\n\n - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.\n\nWe believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team.
